requirement_summary: 02_FUNCTIONAL_REQUIREMENTS_AND_PROGRAMS.md FR-COM-012: 'Seat는 담당자 변경 시 Customer Admin이 즉시 회수·재배정할 수 있으며, 회수된 Seat의 이전 담당자 Access Token은 즉시 무효화한다.'
subject: SemanticAssuranceV2WorkflowService.seatReassignmentRevocationCheck via assurance.seat.reassignment-revocation-check; contracts/seat-reassignment-revocation-check.v1.schema.json (NEW)
coverage_notes: immediate_revocation_confirmed is computed by real per-token cross-referencing, not a caller-declared summary flag. seatReassignmentRevocationCheckDetectsATokenInvalidatedAfterTheReassignment is the direct test of '즉시' (immediate): a token invalidated 5 minutes after reassigned_at is flagged TOKEN_INVALIDATED_AFTER_REASSIGNMENT -- a real window during which the previous occupant's token still worked is caught, not just whether invalidation eventually happened at all. seatReassignmentRevocationCheckDetectsATokenNeverInvalidatedAtAll closes the simpler but equally real case of a token with no invalidation event at all.
open_gap: Operates on a caller-supplied token list and invalidation-event list; there is no live Seat/session-token runtime in this codebase yet that actually issues, tracks, and invalidates real access tokens per seat occupant (same disclosed 'caller-supplied representation, not live system integration' pattern as every other real-computation closure this session -- distinct from the pre-existing SessionLedger, which manages session lifecycle/eviction but has no seat-occupancy or reassignment concept). The reassignment/re-grant half of the requirement ('즉시 회수·재배정') is not modeled by this schema at all -- only the token-revocation half is checked.
